evidence: We have grown HfO2 on Si(001) by atomic layer deposition using HfCl4 and H2O as precursors. The early stages of the ALD were investigated with high-resolution photoelectron spectroscopy and x-ray absorption spectroscopy. ... The XAS spectra were recorded using both the total electron yield (TEY), by measuring the drift current on the sample, and the partial electron yield, by measuring the intensity of the electrons with a kinetic energy of 50 eV with the electron analyzer.
